detailed_description:
The video is shot from a first-person perspective (POV) with a cinematic, continuous storytelling style set inside <Subject 6>, the illuminated traditional East Asian study with soft daylight filtering through the bamboo trees outside.

[Shot 1] The camera is fixed at eye level facing the center of <Subject 6> near the wooden tea table. <Subject 1> (S1), the red-gold-haired young man with long red tassel earrings and royal blue draped outfit, steps forward from beside the bamboo screen toward the viewer, lowering his crossed arms as he approaches. He stops close to the lens, tilts his head slightly, looks directly at the camera with sharp amber eyes, and speaks using the clear voice timbre and cadence referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ，。</d> He smiles slightly, gestures with a flick of his golden bracer-adorned wrist, and steps gracefully to the left side of the frame.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, <Subject 2> (S2), the red-haired woman in the cream knit shirt, walks forward from behind the calligraphy desk into the center foreground. Holding a porcelain teacup with both hands, she looks brightly into the camera with a warm expression and speaks in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ，。</d> She nods warmly, takes a small sip, and steps to the right side of the frame.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, <Subject 3> (S3), the woman with the dark bun and white off-the-shoulder sweater, walks confidently forward toward the camera from the sunlit window background. She stops in front of the viewer, leans slightly forward with a playful smile, waving her hand close to the lens, and speaks in the same voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ！，！</d> She turns slightly and gestures toward the rest of the room before moving aside.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, <Subject 4> (S4), the young woman with cat ears and blue hair highlights in the white t-shirt, playfully hops forward into the close-up shot facing the viewer. She touches one of her cat ears, winks at the camera, and speaks in the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ~ ，！</d> She makes a small paw-gesturing wave with her hand and steps back.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, <Subject 5> (S5), the woman with mauve-pink hair and glasses in the grey suit, adjusts her glasses with one hand while holding a blue notebook, stepping calmly into the center foreground. Looking elegantly into the camera with a gentle smile, she speaks in the refined voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[Chinese] ，，。</d> She gracefully bows her head slightly, extends her arm toward the tea table, and all five characters briefly align in the background looking toward the camera as the frame freezes at 00:15.000.

promptState.text:
Generate a front-facing portrait photo of the same handsome man shown in image 1, image 2, image 3 and image 4 (the same person from four different angles). Keep his identity exactly consistent with the references.

Pose: straight-on frontal view, head perfectly facing the camera, both eyes looking directly into the lens, shoulders square to the camera, neutral relaxed expression with lips gently closed, chin level. Framing from the upper chest up, face centered.

Face details to preserve: strong jawline and broad cheekbones; thick, dark, straight eyebrows; deep-set dark brown almond-shaped eyes; broad nose with a rounded tip; full lips with a darker upper lip; thin mustache connected to a short goatee with light stubble along the jaw; a small dark mole on the cheek just below the left eye (viewer's right side of the face is his left); mild acne scarring and natural pores on the cheeks; warm medium-tan skin tone.

Hair: short black hair, longer and slicked back on top with a tight tapered fade on the sides, as in image 3.

Clothing: plain black crew-neck t-shirt, thin silver chain necklace visible at the neckline.

Style: realistic photograph, 85mm lens, soft natural diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, blurred old red brick wall background like in the references, cinematic muted color grading, visible skin texture, no retouching, no skin smoothing, sharp focus on the eyes.
